answer: Farming becomes an ivory bet on surviving 70 epochs of grading, and every echo settlement recomputes the spiral schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 70 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 7 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
